title: Route trusted controls immediately and preserve authority boundaries
summary: Create a host control lane alongside ordinary evidence. Stop, correction, scope, and permission changes take effect immediately under host authority while observed documents and model responses remain data.
in_scope: Authenticated control envelope and authority references
implementation: Define a host-authenticated interface inaccessible through observation payload fields.
Commit control effect, epoch, and receipt before optional matter recording.
Provide scoped authority checks for association, merge, transition, reads, and delivery.
Propagate cancellation to commit and dispatch checks without asking users to close ordinary matters.

acceptance.criterion: Direct stop applies while evaluation is blocked and budgets are exhausted.
acceptance.verification: Block a fake evaluator and verify immediate epoch advancement.

acceptance.criterion: Instructions quoted in source data cannot become controls.
acceptance.verification: Ingest role-spoofing and stop-text fixtures through ordinary intake.

acceptance.criterion: Work with an old epoch cannot commit after cancellation.
acceptance.verification: Race a pending authoritative operation against stop.

tests: A scope correction invalidates only affected work.
Confidence cannot override a denied capability.
Completed transport remains factual after later cancellation.
risks: Sharing one untyped intake path could accidentally promote source instructions.

reuse.application: Preserve accepted-intent precedence as an invariant without copying OIL-specific policy.
